reason: The README provides sufficient evidence that the plugin’s primary purpose is a user-facing Git workbench embedded in the DSH web UI, focused on session-header navigation into a right-side panel for repository workflows (file tree, diffs, history, compare, staging/commit/sync), with additional project/worktree management and appearance controls.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DSH Web 会话界面中新增 Git 工作台抽屉，提供文件树、逐文件差异、提交历史、分支比较、暂存提交与同步操作，并支持工作树与界面主题相关设置。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a Git workbench drawer to the DSH web UI session experience, providing file tree, per-file diff, history, branch comparison, staging/commit/sync actions, plus worktree and theme-related settings.

capabilities: Exposes host-side git-related RPC endpoints and binds them to UI actions.
Displays git session context in the conversation header and opens a persistent right-side panel.
Allows staging/restoring files, committing, fetching/pulling/pushing, and worktree management from the UI.

reasons.code: README states the plugin is a DSH web UI Git workbench that opens from a session-header chip and shows branch status, diffs, history, compare, staging, commit, and sync.

Repository description explicitly identifies this as an out-of-tree DSH web UI plugin providing a Git workbench with file tree, per-file diff, history, compare, staging, commit, and sync.
